svg.title: Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm trace
svg.desc: Weighted graph with 6 nodes and step-by-step distance table showing how shortest paths are discovered
svg.text: 1. Start: dist[A]=0, all others=∞. Pick unvisited node with min distance.
2. Pick A (dist=0): Update neighbors → B=4, C=2
3. Pick C (dist=2, minimum): Update → E=2+3=5, F=2+6=8, B=min(4, 2+1)=3 → stays 4
5. Continue until all nodes settled (greedy: always pick minimum unvisited)
⚠ Does NOT work with negative weights!
